theorems.statement: ∀ (n r : ℕ), r ≤ n → ∀ t : ℂ, MvPolynomial.eval (fun j : Fin 2 => if j = 0 then 1 else -t) ((fun p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ => MvPolynomial.pderiv (1 : Fin 2) p)^[r] (HeckeEis.linePow n t).val) = (if r = n then (Nat.factorial n : ℂ) else 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Set L = C(t)X₀ + X₁. Since ∂₁L = 1, induction gives ∂₁ʳ(Lⁿ) = C(n.descFactorial r)L^(n−r). Evaluation at (1,−t) sends L to zero. For r<n the result vanishes; for r=n it equals n!, including n=r=0.
